info.title: GATEWAY-batchinsertion-List Logistics Shipments Labels-v5-spec
info.description: The Logistics Shipments Label Retrieval API provides functionality to access and retrieve labels associated with logistics shipments. This endpoint enables businesses to quickly obtain shipping labels, facilitating streamlined operations for logistics and fulfillment teams. Typical consumers include shipping coordinators and warehouse managers who require real-time access to shipment documentation for processing and auditing purposes. By leveraging this API, users can enhance their efficiency and ensure accuracy in labeling shipments across various logistics operations.

get.description: This endpoint allows you to retrieve the label associated with a specific shipment, providing details necessary for shipping and tracking.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to specify the parameters needed to retrieve shipment label information. It must adhere to the defined schema to ensure proper processing of the request.
